a.text: 'And the tracks run hauling my home with creak and cry,'
'I found an acorn rolling in the gutter all alone, and right by a rivet rusted all of its chrome...'

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We've entered the warehouse. Investigation team, report status.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Leader. Vital signs to the southeast. Seven shelves away from you, moving within one meter.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Number of heads?

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: One.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Any Originium response?

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: None for the time being.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. Hold your positions.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What are you looking for?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Doesn't it sound like someone's singin'?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't get distracted. This means our target's guard is down.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Keep to the plan. Wait for my signal, then you charge. For now, keep moving in.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Five, four, three...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ready—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Bunker destroyed!

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Ack—

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *hack*... Wh—what's going on? All this smoke out of nowhere!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't move! Stay where you are, raise both your hands up!

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: I—I... you're... Victorian soldiers?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What do you mean by that? Aren't you Victorian too?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: He's looking to run. Cello, watch to intercept!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, he's not headin' for the exit, he's turned back—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Triangle! Target heading for the back shelves! If you pick up any Originium response, open fire immediately!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Everyone else, form behind my shield!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Quick!!!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe, what are you doing?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'm coverin' it! Everyone, run!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Leader, no Originium response. That's not a bomb under Bagpipe.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh! False alarm.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: And the target...?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Sorry, I knocked him a little hard. He won't be standin' for a while.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: And what of the boxes?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'll take a peek. All potatoes and carrots, and cauliflowers too! I squashed 'em flat. Shame, they seemed just fine for eatin'.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Stay alert.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: This one, this one, and this one... they're all the same. Leader, it's all produce and grains in here.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Triangle, watch for anyone else nearing our perimeter.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Oboe, you search the warehouse with Bagpipe. Signal on any discovery.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Cello, take this man stuck on the floor and tie him up.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Right now, sir, we're going to need you to answer a few questions.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: I—I don't know anything. I'm here for sorting the potatoes.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Are you from County Hillock?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Have you heard of any spectre force?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Spectre... what? *cough*, *cough* *cough*... Doesn't force mean people like you lot, all the soldiers?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: They took Lowry, Julia and Chris away... is it—is it my turn now?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I want you to calm down.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Listen. We have people who saw a batch of Originium goods enter this warehouse late last night. And now, those goods aren't here. You need to give me an explanation.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Explanation? That's what you're looking for? You're not going to just hang me? I—I... *pteuch*.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Hey! What are you spittin' around for? You've gotta care about hygiene!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Any leads?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: None, it's potatoes everywhere. If our information wasn't wrong, then they must work a sight fast.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bring him. He definitely knows something, he's just not willing to open up.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: There it is... you're all the same! Dying to find faults in all of us, torturing us... you Victorian oppressor beasts!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh? Again? He thinks callin' another Victorian 'Victorian' counts as an insult? It's flyin' over my head.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Leader, incoming.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: How many?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Prepare to break up.)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Yes, Leader.)

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Update, Leader, they seem to be our own.
They're in here.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Leader, we're surrounded.)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Going by the numbers, yes.)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (If you listen to the voices, there don't seem to be too many left outside. If I crack the wall by me, then we've got our chance!)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Don't get hasty.)
I see you've had a very fierce confrontation in here.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Rita Skamandros, 7th Frontline Infantry Battalion, 2nd Tempest Platoon Leader.
Nice to meet you, Lieutenant Skamm... Skamandros.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: My name isn't too easy to remember. You can call me Horn, Captain.
Very well, Horn. I'm Kelly, Louis Kelly. I'm sorry, codenames aren't our style.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Captain Kelly, you and your troops are presumably also here to investigate this warehouse.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Correct, we've received the tip-off too.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Then you ought to understand how grave this situation is. A great deal of illicit Originium goods were stolen off a military transport a couple months ago, and ultimately came to vanish in this region.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Ahem...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I need not remind you, Captain, with this much ordnance, coupled with recent thefts in surrounding counties—if fallen into felonious hands, the menace posed will reach far beyond County Hillock.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Good, thank you for the run-down. I understand.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: And we're very thankful for your cooperation.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Hill!

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Sir.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Take this young man... this suspect back to camp.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What? It was mad for us gettin' this man as our lead!

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Sir, her spear is obstructing fulfillment of my duty.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe, let it go.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But our mission—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: —We're on Hillock land right now.
Captain Kelly pulls a handkerchief from his pocket, and wipes the sweat on his forehead.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Very glad we could persuade you, Lieutenant. You and this young Vouivre lady, and all others present...

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Ahem—you must be certainly worn out by your hard journey, dashing here from Londinium.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's our duty as soldiers of Victoria.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Yes, quite right. Now, if you still have intention to operate in County Hillock...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We're obliged to continue tracking the thieved Originium goods. This is an order from Londinium. I imagine Colonel Hamilton would see sense too.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Of course, of course. You may accompany me back to camp.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, do we really have to give him up to them? They have to be doin' this on purpose! Ever since we touched foot on the outskirt plate, they've been followin' right behind!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Right until now, just as we caught him—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: 'Stationed troops of the Empire have a responsibility to address any threat to public safety that arises within their station.'

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: They haven't violated any code.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh... alright.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Captain, he's yours. As per code, we may also take part in the interrogation—we hope you recall.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Ha, hahah... yes, quite in line with code.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: N—No... let me go! Don't take me!

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Heh...

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Help me... save my soul! I haven't done anything... I don't know...

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Aaarghhh!

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Hill...

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Tara rabble like him always do make a scene like this.

steps.name: Captain Kelly
steps.text: Take him away.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh, really! What gives them the right!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (Leader, I think... that wee Feline wants us to help him. He's scared to death of goin' with them.)

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Triangle?)

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Here, Leader. Still in position, outside in the same tree. They haven't noticed me.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: (Good. Take the reconnaissance group, and keep investigating along nearby transport routes. If you find any leads, immediately report back.)

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Understood. Are we notifying their barracks?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Be sure to defend yourselves.
